prerequisites: Basic understanding of computer science concepts and algorithms; familiarity with introductory statistics and probability is beneficial but not mandatory.
description: Understand the fundamentals of AI and its potential for decision making. To introduce the concept of artificial intelligence, methods, techniques and applications. Gain practical experience through case studies and hands-on projects.

syllabus.title: Introduction to AI and Decision Making
syllabus.body: Fundamentals of AI: definitions, history, key concepts. Decision-making frameworks: rationality, bounded rationality, intuition. The role of AI in decision making: opportunities and challenges.

syllabus.title: Problem Solving
syllabus.body: State space search; production systems, search space control; depth first search, breadth-first search. Heuristic based search: hill climbing, best-first search, A* algorithm and AO* algorithm, min-max algorithms, game playing - alpha beta pruning branch and bound, problem reduction, constraint satisfaction, means-end analysis.

syllabus.title: Representing and Reasoning with Uncertain Knowledge
syllabus.body: Probability, connection to logic, independence, Bayes rule, Bayesian networks, probabilistic inference, sample applications.

syllabus.title: Decision-Making
syllabus.body: Basics of utility theory, decision theory, sequential decision problems, elementary game theory, sample applications.

syllabus.title: Machine Learning
syllabus.body: Introduction, machine learning process, supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning; feature engineering - extraction and selection, data visualization: line chart, bar chart, pie chart, histograms, scatter plot; learning nearest neighbour, naive Bayes, and decision tree classifiers, Q-learning for learning action policies, applications.

syllabus.title: Applications of AI
syllabus.body: AI in healthcare: diagnosis, treatment, and medical imaging; AI in finance: fraud detection, algorithmic trading, and risk assessment; AI in transportation: autonomous vehicles and traffic optimization; AI in customer service and chatbots; AI in education: personalized learning and intelligent tutoring systems.

outcomes: Demonstrate fundamental understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its foundation.
Analyse basic and advanced search techniques.
Illustrate the concept of decision-making and machine learning.
Apply basic principles of ML algorithms and models in various application domains.
textbooks: Rich E., Knight K. and Nair B. S., Artificial Intelligence, Tata McGraw Hills, 3rd ed., 2009.
Luger F. G., Artificial Intelligence: Structures and Strategies for Complex Problem Solving, Pearson Education Asia, 6th ed., 2009.
referenceBooks: Patterson W. D., Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Expert Systems, Pearson, 1st ed., 2015.
Russel S., Norvig P., Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach, Prentice Hall, 3rd ed., 2014.
